questions.text: Explain the characteristics of a Cattle-Rearing Society.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the characteristics of a Cattle-Rearing Society. (D)

answer.value:
This society is large in size and sometimes includes hundreds and even thousands of people. For example, the Bakhtiyar community still consists of about 5,000 to 1,50,000 people.
This society is generally found in grasslands, hilly regions, deserts, and areas not suitable for agriculture. Such regions are favourable for animal rearing; therefore, their main occupation is pastoralism.
In this society, those who own more livestock are more influential than others. They are considered wealthy and become leaders of others.

questions.text: Explain the features of an industrial society.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the features of an industrial society. (D)

answer.value:
New inventions have brought about social change. The steam engine, internal combustion engine, electric power, nuclear energy, etc., have brought and continue to bring wide-ranging social and economic transformations.
People migrate to cities where industries are established in search of jobs. Therefore, the population increases.
Division of labour is necessary to run industries. Division of labour means distributing work based on skills. It is seen in all sectors of industrial society.
In one sense, this classification can also be considered as stages in the evolution of human society.
